name: 95206 · Stockton, CA
findings: ZIP 95206 (Stockton) has 94 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (26%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 17 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95206 (Stockton) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 95206 (Stockton) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 46% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 34 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
